dynamic_line: Sure, I've got some supplies on hand, just give me a minute and you'll be right as rain.  It'll cost three icons.

responses.text: I can pay for quality work.  Here it is.

dynamic_line.yes: I'm up for it, Arturo's got enough medicine for two-and-half months.  It's thankless work around here, so let's blow this joint.
dynamic_line.no: I'd like to leave, but I've got to take care of Arturo.  He's always low or nearly out of antipsychotics, so I do what I can.
